summary: Compatibility, clean dictionaries, custom imports and detailed diagnostics

changes.title: Compatibility and power handling
changes.detail: Optional visual quality follows a local 19% threshold in this edition; respect real system compositor availability and accessibility, recover from visibility and capability changes, and provide an optional Android battery settings shortcut.

changes.title: Custom additions and punctuation
changes.detail: A searchable Custom page brings emoji font and swipe library import together. A default-off comma and full stop toggle adds direct punctuation beside space in regular alphabet rows without changing email, URL or numeric rows.

changes.title: Safer import and dictionary provenance
changes.detail: Use bounded staged validation, atomic font replacement, native ELF checks and recoverable checksum transactions. Exclude two unverified backup-derived Hindi dictionaries; retain the English emoji dictionary after an exact public CLDR/Signal binary match, generic vocabulary and existing explicitly imported and learned data.

changes.title: Complete local diagnostics
changes.detail: Extend the safe report with source revision, power state, blur request status, motion failure codes, own-process exit metadata, model and library status and memory. Generate it off the UI thread; no raw editor text, audio, clipboard, unrelated logs or new permissions.

changes.title: Offline voice model package
changes.detail: The selected one-time package includes the pinned Parakeet Ultra model and retains the existing verified local installation and migration path. Future regular packages omit the model weights.
